description: The line plot illustrates the performance of two models—“MATTER (ours)” and “w/o material information”—as measured by their Macro-F1 Score (%) across varying numbers of tokens, ranging from approximately 0.6 to 1.5 on the x-axis. The y-axis, labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, spans from 48% to 58%, with major gridlines at 2% intervals. The “MATTER (ours)” model is represented by a pink line with circular markers and a light pink shaded region indicating uncertainty or variance; it begins at ~55.1% at 0.6 tokens, dips slightly to ~54.4% at 0.7, rises to a peak of ~58.0% at 1.0 tokens, then declines to ~50.8% at 1.5 tokens. The “w/o material information” model is shown with a purple line and circular markers, with a light purple shaded region; it starts at ~52.4% at 0.6 tokens, rises to ~54.1% at 0.7, then gradually declines to ~51.8% at 1.3, before dropping sharply to ~47.5% at 1.5 tokens. Both lines exhibit fluctuations, but “MATTER (ours)” consistently outperforms the ablated version across most token counts, especially between 0.8 and 1.4 tokens, where it maintains scores above 55%, while the ablated model remains below 54% after 0.8 tokens. The shaded regions around each line suggest variability in performance, with wider bands indicating greater uncertainty, particularly for “MATTER (ours)” near 1.0 tokens and for the ablated model near 1.5 tokens.
